title: Seasoned Chicken Breast
description: Tyson fresh chicken breasts, seasoned and cooked in the oven's Air Fry mode. 1 breast per serving.

ingredients.note: or a dry rub she likes in place of the seasonings

steps: Preheat oven on Air Fry mode to 400°F. Lightly oiled sheet pan, rack on top if you have one.
If a breast is very thick on one end, pound it to an even 3/4 inch (in a bag, with a pan bottom), or slice it in half horizontally. Even thickness = juicy chicken.
Pat dry, rub with oil, season both sides.
Done when the thickest part reads 165°F and juices run clear. Rest 5 min before slicing.
source: Joe's Meal Pack, Oct 20 to Nov 4, 2026 (built by Thrifty, now kept by Meal Plan), R11
notes:
25 to 30 min. Made for Joe's girlfriend. Cook the whole pack if it's more than you need; extra sliced chicken works on a potato bar or in a sandwich.
Tyson chicken breast chunks (raw, about 1 inch) have their own untested Air Fry settings from Oven Air Fry Chef in methods/tyson-chicken-chunks-air-fry.md. They are not this recipe's settings, because this recipe uses whole breasts.
Foil removed Oct 25, 2026 (Joe has no foil); per Joe via Meal Plan.

healthy: Chicken breast is lean, high protein meat.
not_healthy: No vegetables or fiber on its own.
